info.title: SDA Property Backend API
info.description: Backend-only property inventory, private documents, exclusive property deal reservations, enquiries, leads, follow-ups, visits and scoped reports. Deal amounts are records, not payment collection.

get.description: Requires property-reports + reports:read; agents also requires property-reports.agents. Each source independently requires ACL + token ability: properties/properties:read, properties.enquiries/enquiries:read, leads/leads:read, leads.view/leads:read (follow-ups), visits/visits:read. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Dates select created_at for properties/enquiries/leads, due date for tasks, starts_at for visits. Current ownership/status, not historical snapshots. No default date bound.

get.description: Requires property-reports + reports:read; agents also requires property-reports.agents. Each source independently requires ACL + token ability: properties/properties:read, properties.enquiries/enquiries:read, leads/leads:read, leads.view/leads:read (follow-ups), visits/visits:read. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Dates select created_at for properties/enquiries/leads, due date for tasks, starts_at for visits. Current ownership/status, not historical snapshots. No default date bound. Only agents with matching accessible leads or visits are returned; inactive agents with history included. At least one lead/visit source is required. Metrics from inaccessible sources are null. Separate grouped subqueries prevent duplicated counts; ordered by user ID.

get.description: Requires properties role permission, the document action permission and the corresponding documents:read/write token ability. All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. Fresh login required for new abilities. Requires properties.documents / documents:read. Newest ID first; no document metadata is embedded in general property resources.

post.description: Requires properties role permission, the document action permission and the corresponding documents:read/write token ability. All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. Fresh login required for new abilities. Requires properties.documents.create / documents:write. Single multipart file. Server controls property, uploader, MIME, bytes, checksum and UUID path. Repeated POST creates a separate document. Database rollback attempts new-file removal.

All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. delete.description: Requires properties role permission, the document action permission and the corresponding documents:read/write token ability. All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. Fresh login required for new abilities. Requires properties.documents.delete / documents:write. Parent property deletion also removes documents under property-delete permission. Cleanup command is scheduled hourly; deployment must run Laravel scheduler. Database rollback preserves existing bytes.

204.description: Document inaccessible after commit. Private file removed after commit; failed cleanup retains an inaccessible tombstone for property-documents:cleanup retries. Repeated deletion is 404.

post.summary: Reserve one property for a lead customer
post.description: Requires deals.create + deals.view / deals:write. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Requires available inventory and an open lead with customer. Property/lead/customer/purpose/currency snapshots derived server-side; amount strings normalized exactly. Status becomes reserved and public catalogue/enquiries exclude the property. Parent locking/current reads and a unique active-property guard serialize bookings. Financial fields immutable; audit and inventory changes are atomic. No payment/refund processing. Existing matching request returns the same scoped deal without repeating mutations.

patch.description: Requires deals.confirm + deals.view / deals:write. Reserved becomes confirmed; property becomes sold (sale) or rented (rent). Revalidates current sources, hold, purpose/rental period and customer identity. Does not change CRM lead stage or transfer money. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Repeating the same terminal action preserves timestamps, reasons and events. Confirmed/cancelled deals cannot reopen or change terminal state. Reserved property deletion is blocked; controlled status/purpose/rental period cannot be changed by ordinary property PUT.

patch.description: Requires deals.cancel + deals.view / deals:write. Reserved becomes cancelled and releases only its own hold to available, without overriding an externally changed status. Requires cancellation_reason. Recorded advance retained; no refund action. Closed/missing lead/customer does not prevent cancellation. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Repeating the same terminal action preserves timestamps, reasons and events. Confirmed/cancelled deals cannot reopen or change terminal state. Reserved property deletion is blocked; controlled status/purpose/rental period cannot be changed by ordinary property PUT.

PropertyWrite.description: Reserved is managed by deal reservations. Active reserved/confirmed deals prevent ordinary PUT changing controlled status, purpose or rental period. Reserved cannot be set on property creation.

FollowUpWrite.description: Notes require comment; tasks require title and timezone-qualified due_at.

PropertyReportCounts.description: Current status of inventory created within the period, including unpublished and deal-reserved properties.

EnquiryReportCounts.description: Enquiries created within the period; lead linkage reflects the current FK, not a workflow status.

LeadReportCounts.description: Leads created within the period. Current stage code determines outcome; missing stage is unclassified. Not a historical status report.

FollowUpReportCounts.description: Distinct tasks linked to visible leads, filtered by due date. Overdue means pending with due date strictly before as_of. Notes excluded; undated tasks included only without date bounds.

VisitReportCounts.description: Visits filtered by starts_at. Current status buckets; upcoming means scheduled with starts_at >= as_of.

ReportPeriod.description: Inclusive calendar-day filters in the configured application timezone. Null bounds are unbounded.

OverviewReport.description: Null means missing source ACL/token ability; permitted empty sections have zero counts.

original_name.description: Sanitized download filename with normalized extension, not a storage path.

download_url.description: Relative API download URL; requires Authorization header and current scope.

file.description: Single PDF/JPEG/PNG, up to 10 MiB. Actual MIME must match pdf/jpg/jpeg/png extension. Maximum 50 active documents per property.

request_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key. Same creator and equivalent payload replay existing deal with 200, including terminal deals. Different payload/creator is 409.

agreed_price.description: Positive negotiated total commitment, maximum 9999999999999.99. Must be a decimal string; JSON numbers rejected.

booking_amount.description: Recorded advance included in agreed total, at most agreed_price. Not online payment or a separate security deposit.
